visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a black motorcycle jacket and a gray Shoei helmet rides a large adventure motorcycle through a narrow road carved directly into a massive, steep rock cliff. The lighting is bright daylight, highlighting the rough textures of the gray stone wall on the right. (2) The scene cuts to a wider mountain road with green slopes in the distance. A dark SUV is parked on a dirt shoulder next to some orange traffic cones and a green pipe. The sky is bright blue with a few clouds. (3) The camera follows a black SUV driving down a two-lane mountain highway with yellow lines. Tall, rugged limestone cliffs tower on both sides, creating a deep canyon effect under the harsh sun. (4) The rider is shown from a front-facing action camera mounted on the handlebars, maneuvering through a series of winding turns. Lush green trees and foliage line the left side of the road, casting dappled shadows. (5) The motorcycle passes through a sunlit forest section with tall trees and a yellow guardrail. The camera angle shifts to show the rider's upper body and the digital display of the motorcycle. (6) The rider enters a dark, narrow tunnel with artificial yellow lights reflecting off the wet pavement. The camera captures the rapid movement through the confined space before emerging back into the mountain scenery. (7) A unique 'little planet' 360-degree camera effect is used, showing the rider in the center of a distorted spherical view of the mountain road, surrounding peaks, and a bright blue sky filled with white clouds.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to showcase the high quality and scenic beauty of Taiwan's mountain highways (specifically Suhua, Central Cross-Island, and Alishan) for motorcycle enthusiasts. It uses a favorable comparison to Japan's roads to emphasize that Taiwan's mountain infrastructure is excellent for focused, rhythmic riding without the annoyance of frequent speed cameras or poor road surfaces.
